blurb: Guests race high-powered electric karts on multi-level tracks with tiered racing classes from Starter to Pro. The facility includes arcade games, duckpin bowling, shuffleboard, laser tag, gel blaster battles, and dining at Nemo's Trackside. Group events and private parties are hosted with catering and exclusive track access options.
